caption_L1: Breakdown of 55,924 sample patients infected with novel coronavirus COVID-19 in China as of February 22 , 2020 , by symptom is a bar chart. The x-axis measures Share of patients while the y-axis measures Response.
caption_L2L3: The most common symptom presented by Corona Virus patients was fever, followed by a dry cough, fatigue and sputum production respectively. Chills, shortness of breath, headache, muscle and joint pain, shortness of breath and sore throat were also identified by patients. Among the least common symptoms were diarrhoea, nasal congestion and vomiting / nausea.
